title: The floor test: can you stand up without your hands?
caption: Can you get up off the floor without using your hands? Take the floor test, then find your level: Supported Sit-to-Stand, Sit-to-Stand, Reverse Lunge or Single-Leg Sit-to-Stand. Do your level every day and test again in two weeks. Save this and retest.

overlays.text: Can you stand up from the floor without your hands? Try it, then swipe.

scenes.footer: Notice what you needed: both hands, one hand, a knee, or nothing.

overlays.text: Sit on the floor, legs crossed. Stand up without your hands, a knee or the couch.

scenes.footer: Do this every day. Move on when your hands barely help.

overlays.text: Start here. Supported Sit-to-Stand. 8 reps. Hands on the chair, stand, sit down slowly.

scenes.footer: Move on when all 8 feel easy.

overlays.text: Sit-to-Stand. 8 reps. Arms folded, stand up from the chair, sit down slowly.

scenes.footer: This is the move you used to get up. Now it gets stronger.

overlays.text: Reverse Lunge. 6 each side. Step one foot back, lower the knee, stand up.
Single-Leg Sit-to-Stand. 4 reps. One leg, no hands, up from the chair.

scenes.footer: Same floor, same test. Write down what you needed.

overlays.text: Do your level every day. Take the floor test again in two weeks.

scenes.footer: Save this and retest in two weeks.

overlays.text: What did you need: both hands, one hand, a knee, or nothing?
